step1_analysis.description: Two parallel single-balanced active mixers sharing a single-ended RF input, driven by quadrature LO signals to produce differential I and Q IF outputs. It serves as the first downconversion stage in a Weaver image-reject receiver.

paper_reference.title: A 2-GHz CMOS Image-Reject Receiver With LMS Calibration

Conversion Gain.description: Ratio of the differential IF output voltage amplitude to the RF input voltage amplitude.

paper_reported.value: 57 dB (entire receiver IRR, not mixer gain)

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming V_bias=0.9V, Id ~ 310uA, gm ~ 1.3mS. With 2kOhm load resistors, CG = (2/pi) * gm * Rload = 0.636 * 1.3mS * 2kOhm = 1.65 V/V = 4.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Mixer conversion gain depends heavily on the chosen load resistors and bias current. 4-5 dB is typical for a simple active mixer with 2k loads.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the mixer core from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ~ 310uA per RF transconductor. Total current for I and Q branches = 620uA. Power = 620uA * 1.8V = 1.1 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The mixer core alone consumes a small fraction of the total receiver power.

I/Q Gain Mismatch.description: Difference in conversion gain between the I and Q channels.

sky130_expected.calculation: In a nominal schematic simulation with identical components, mismatch should be near zero.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without Monte Carlo variations, the simulated mismatch is limited only by numerical precision and simulation artifacts.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure Conversion Gain, Power Consumption, and I/Q Gain Mismatch of the I/Q mixer. Uses a 2.4 GHz RF input and 2.399 GHz LO inputs to generate a 1 MHz IF. RC low-pass filters are added at the IF outputs to suppress LO feedthrough inherent to single-balanced mixers.
step3_testbench.spice:
* I/Q Downconversion Mixer Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u

XM3 VIFI_P N7 X GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM2 Y VRF GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 VIFI_N VLOI_N X GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM6 VIFQ_N VLOQ_N Y GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM1 X VRF GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM5 VIFQ_P VLOQ_P Y GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Load resistors and capacitors (Low-pass filter for IF)
RLI_P VDD VIFI_P 2k
CLI_P VIFI_P 0 20p
RLI_N VDD VIFI_N 2k
CLI_N VIFI_N 0 20p
RLQ_P VDD VIFQ_P 2k
CLQ_P VIFQ_P 0 20p
RLQ_N VDD VIFQ_N 2k
CLQ_N VIFQ_N 0 20p

* RF Input (2.4 GHz)
VRF VRF 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 10m 2.4G)

* LO Inputs (2.399 GHz)
VN7 N7 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.4 2.399G 0 0 0)
VVLOI_N VLOI_N 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.4 2.399G 0 0 180)
VVLOQ_P VLOQ_P 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.4 2.399G 0 0 90)
VVLOQ_N VLOQ_N 0 dc 0.9 sin(0.9 0.4 2.399G 0 0 270)

.control
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power

  * Transient analysis for conversion gain
  tran 20p 3u
  
  * IF is at 1 MHz. Period is 1 us.
  * Measure peak-to-peak of IF output
  let vifi_diff = v(VIFI_P) - v(VIFI_N)
  meas tran if_max max vifi_diff from=1u to=3u
  meas tran if_min min vifi_diff from=1u to=3u
  let if_pp = if_max - if_min
  let rf_pp = 20m
  let cg_linear = if_pp / rf_pp
  let cg_db = 20 * log10(cg_linear)
  print cg_db
  
  * Measure Q channel
  let vifq_diff = v(VIFQ_P) - v(VIFQ_N)
  meas tran ifq_max max vifq_diff from=1u to=3u
  meas tran ifq_min min vifq_diff from=1u to=3u
  let ifq_pp = ifq_max - ifq_min
  let cgq_linear = ifq_pp / rf_pp
  let cgq_db = 20 * log10(cgq_linear)
  print cgq_db
  
  let gain_mismatch_db = abs(cg_db - cgq_db)
  print gain_mismatch_db

  quit
.endc
